say:2:1028207001:1.text: Chippy is sorry. Chippy didn't mean to eat his offerings.
say:2:1028207001:1.source_cn: 很对不起那个孩子，可满满也不是故意吃掉贡果的呀……

say:3:1028207002:1.text: Magister, can we help fulfill his wish and help him discover his special talent? Then, he can return to the academy in peace.
say:3:1028207002:1.source_cn: 主人，咱们能不能帮他实现愿望，找到天赋？这样他就能安心...
say:3:1028207002:1.male: Magister, can we help fulfill his wish and help him discover his special talent? Then, he can return to the academy in peace.
say:3:1028207002:1.female: Magister, can we help fulfill his wish and help him discover his special talent? Then, he can return to the academy in peace.

say:4:1028207003:1.text: But we can't just give someone a special talent. Even the magister can't do that.
say:4:1028207003:1.source_cn: 可是……给予别人“天赋”，这种事情根本不可能，就连梅林...
say:4:1028207003:1.male: But we can't just give someone a special talent. Even the magister can't do that.
say:4:1028207003:1.female: But we can't just give someone a special talent. Even the magister can't do that.

say:5:1028207004:1.text: Chippy knows this, but... Chippy ate his fruit.
say:5:1028207004:1.source_cn: 满满知道，但是、但是……满满吃了他的果子嘛。
say:5:1028207004:1.male: Chippy knows this, but... Chippy ate his fruit.
say:5:1028207004:1.female: Chippy knows this, but... Chippy ate his fruit.

say:7:1028207006:1.text: Only because you insisted I try it!
say:7:1028207006:1.source_cn: 那、那还不是你一定要我尝尝！

choice_prompt:8:1028207006.text: Only because you insisted I try it!
choice_prompt:8:1028207006.source_cn: 那、那还不是你一定要我尝尝！

say:9:1028207007:1.text: B-But Chippy can't do it alone...
say:9:1028207007:1.source_cn: 可是，可是满满一个人做不到呀……

say:10:1028207008:1.text: Even with Hammie, it's not enough... We need your help, Magister Merlin...
say:10:1028207008:1.source_cn: 加上漫漫也不行……还是需要梅林的帮助……梅林~
say:10:1028207008:1.male: Even with Hammie, it's not enough... We need your help, Magister Merlin...
say:10:1028207008:1.female: Even with Hammie, it's not enough... We need your help, Magister Merlin...

say:11:1028207009:1.text: We can't do it without you!
say:11:1028207009:1.male: We can't do it without you!
say:11:1028207009:1.female: We can't do it without you!

say:14:1028207011:1.text: Hmm... it was our mistake, after all, Chippy. Let's give it our all.
say:14:1028207011:1.source_cn: 唔……毕竟是我们犯下的错误，满满，咱们加油吧。

say:15:1028207012:1.text: As long as <style="stress"><player_name></style> can give us the occasional reminder, we can do this!
say:15:1028207012:1.male: As long as <style="stress"><player_name></style> can give us the occasional reminder, we can do this!
say:15:1028207012:1.female: As long as <style="stress"><player_name></style> can give us the occasional reminder, we can do this!

say:17:1028207014:1.text: Okay! Where did that little boy go? Quick! Let's find him!
say:17:1028207014:1.source_cn: ——哎呀，那个小男孩呢？他是不是跑远了？！咱们得赶快跟上他！

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 你们是优秀的使魔！加油！

choice:8:0:1.text: He at fault should make amends.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 让犯错的人来解决问题吧
choice:8:0:1.male: He at fault should make amends.
choice:8:0:1.female: He at fault should make amends.
